observations.workerLifetimeEvidence: The actual worker returned both digests. transport_control.py:62 retains its Worker object on window; there is no terminate/self.close before context close at :69. No separate post-result liveness ping was acquired.
observations.responseStatusEvidence: The server source emits HTTP 200 at transport_control.py:37 and native read rejects non-ok responses. The result itself lacks a browser response.status field; do not describe it as separately captured HTTP-200 telemetry.

causalDisposition.established: All four independent fresh contexts consumed both complete pinned assets, while all four colour requests and both intercepted DEM requests emitted ERR_ABORTED before the observation ended and before context close. Therefore that notification is not sufficient, by itself, to establish incomplete consumption in this bounded setup.
notEstablished: A route-only cause: direct-local colour requests also aborted. DEM outcome differs by arm in these four contexts, which does not explain the original colour failure or justify a route change.
A unique reader.cancel-after-EOF cause: both arms retain that call and there is no uncancelled control.
A general harmless-abort rule, product rendering/pixel success, startup timing success or measured callback-cost result.
causalDisposition.localVsSystemic: The actionable defect is the cost collector inference that any requestfailed notification immediately proves invalid consumer state. Its unconditional rule affects this collector; the evidence does not establish a general browser/network or product defect.
causalDisposition.existingFailureChain: run_cost_v2.py:75 records every failed request as a network violation; :166 then stops readiness before warmup. This explains the Chromium r3 B0 stop without claiming the source of ERR_ABORTED.

nativeConsumptionProof.chain: The identical moon-worker.mjs:5-10 reads through EOF, rejects size mismatch, and retains finally reader.cancel. Boot :15-16 waits for DEM and colour then MoonPool.create. Baseline pool :36-39 creates two shards and waits for both; candidate pool :37-40 creates four and waits for all four. Worker :43 sends each shard-ready only after MoonEngine.create. Both engine sources :39-41 validate compressed length/SHA and :64-73 validate WASM/kernel, decode both assets and initialize numeric assets. Owned native ready is set only by the current worker message (candidate moon-native.mjs:178-180; baseline :144-146). This establishes the validation dependency, not identical pool algorithms or worker counts.
nativeConsumptionProof.limit: Full ready/refined state plus exact single current boot/request/source lineage is source-supported proof of completed native validation, not newly acquired per-fetch EOF/digest telemetry. The r4 record must make that inference explicit.

preparationRequirements.requirement: Retain each raw request start/response/terminal event, failed=true and exact failure string. Add a separate narrowly named classification; do not delete failures, rename them successful transport, or remove unrelated network violations.
preparationRequirements.reason: Validated consumption and transport notification are distinct facts.

preparationRequirements.requirement: Eligibility is exact pinned Chromium, exact slot local origin and canonical DEM/colour URL, GET/fetch, exact net::ERR_ABORTED, actual HTTP 200 and expected compressed Content-Length metadata joined to that request, and admitted compressed length/SHA-256 bound through exact served bytes plus the native consumer chain. No substring/suffix allowlist, redirects, changed query, wrong origin or arbitrary abort kind.
preparationRequirements.reason: The control records only these two assets and this browser. It did not record a browser response.status field; r4 must record it.

preparationRequirements.requirement: Join the request to the current native Moon boot and worker, either directly or by an explicit unique-source invariant: one relevant request per asset, one boot of the sole current Moon owner at the exact asset base, no embedded/offline bypass, no replacement/retry/duplicate request, unchanged source/runtime/manifest and no competing consumer. Require ready=true, disposed=false, a reachable nonterminated current worker, current refined-terrain, no pending Moon job and ready/result/accepted job identity from that same current worker. Initial-v5, a stale worker or an unrelated ready renderer is insufficient. A dedicated-worker initiator ID is not mandatory when this source-based association is complete and honestly labelled.
preparationRequirements.reason: Server bytes or a ready flag without request/owner lineage can mask a failed request.

preparationRequirements.requirement: Deferred startup classification must finish inside the existing readiness and slot bounds. All request terminal times and the full validated consumption/readiness observation must precede quietStartMonotonic. Preserve the existing five-second warmup, five-second observation, boundary-lateness limit and all state matches. Any active request or new/ending network request at or after quietStart invalidates the slot, including an otherwise eligible DEM/colour notification. Compare timing on a common recorded monotonic clock or an explicit valid mapping; do not compare unrelated browser and Python clock values.
preparationRequirements.reason: The exception concerns completed startup transport only; it must not overlap measured work or extend acquisition indefinitely.

preparationRequirements.requirement: Keep all other adverse evidence fail-closed: HTTP error/non-200, missing response, truncated/excess/corrupt/wrong bytes, source/manifest drift, decoder/kernel or boot error, worker replacement/termination, fallback/unavailable/noncurrent scene, page error, missing/ambiguous proof, unmatched/duplicate events, server errors and unrelated network failure.
preparationRequirements.reason: Successful minimal consumers do not make all future ERR_ABORTED events harmless.

Keep the existing runtime/input/raw/cleanup gates.

requiredOfflineControlsForExactR4Review: Positive: exactly one pinned DEM/colour startup abort with actual HTTP 200, exact served identity, current owned ready/refined consumer proof, no outstanding requests, and all evidence before quietStart is separately classified while the raw failed event remains.

Negative: wrong method/URL/origin/query, unrecognized failure text, HTTP non-200/missing status, wrong/missing compressed Content-Length, absent/incorrect byte hash or length, missing terminal event or unjoined server response remains INCOMPLETE.

Negative: initial-v5 only, stale/unrelated owner, wrong boot base, embedded/offline bypass, worker replacement/termination, duplicate asset request or boot, mismatched ready/result/accepted job identity, decoder/boot failure, noncurrent/refinement-pending scene or unavailable proof remains INCOMPLETE.

Boundary: terminal event or readiness proof at/after quietStart, any overlapping request during warmup or observation, pending classification at the original deadline, or mismatched/nonfinite clocks remains INCOMPLETE.

Integrity: a forged driver classification cannot override contradictory raw evidence; driver and independent analyzer reach the same eligibility result; all original cleanup/input/paired-round gates remain in force.
